WELCOME

Knowlan Family Farm offers U-pick apples, as well as peaches, pears, blueberries, blackberries, pumpkins, vegetables, grass-fed beef and family fun. Many other local and farm products are available in our store. 

MORE INFO
OUR APPLES

With over 29 varieties of U-pick apples, you will find something new to try throughout the season. If you aren't in the mood to pick, drop by our farm store for some pre-picked apples, bagged and ready to go. 

VARIETIES
"SURELY THE APPLE IS THE NOBLEST OF FRUITS."
– HENRY DAVID THOREAU
A LOOK AROUND THE FARM

In addition to the fruit trees and vegetable garden, Knowlan Family Farm is home to a herd of Red Angus cattle, sheep, goats, and countless wildlife.

WELCOME TO THE FARM

Knowlan Family Farm offers local fruit, vegetables, beef and family fun. We opened our doors in 2016 and are looking forward to offering more products and activities as we continue to grow. The farm has a wide range of U-pick apple varieties, as well as peaches, pears, blueberries, blackberries, pumpkins, vegetables, grass-fed beef, and other local products. The years to come will also bring more activities for kids and families as we continue to grow. We look forward to seeing you on the farm.

QUARTERS AND SIDES OF BEEF  

Reserve online or contact for details. 

USDA inspected, quarters and sides include a mix of steaks (rib, sirloin, T-bone, flank, skirt), roasts (chuck, arm, rump, sirloin tip), ground beef, and in some quarters, a brisket. A quarter of beef after processing will normally weigh 80 to 90 pounds, and a side will weigh 160 to 180 pounds.  Click the button for detailed information. 

DETAILED INFO SHEET ON QUARTERS/SIDES
LAMB

Knowlan Family Farm now has a flock of sheep and will be selling pasture raised lamb meat on a periodic basis. The sheep are raised on pasture and hay, and occasionally receive supplemental feed. Our ewes are Katahdin hair sheep, and they are crossed with a Dorper ram.
